args.body:
TRELLIS BIOWORKS, INC. — PROJECT LATTICE
SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT (HALBERD HOLDINGS LP / TRELLIS BIOWORKS, INC.)
COUNTER-RIDER TO ARTICLE VIII, SECTION 8.2(d) — SPECIAL INDEMNITY FOR DISCLOSED MATTERS
(Responsive to Halberd second-turn markup transmitted 30 July 2026; new contract text)

New Section 8.2(d) (Special Indemnity for Pending Disclosed Matters). In lieu of and strictly in substitution for the special indemnity proposed in the counterparty's second-turn markup, the following is agreed and shall be inserted as Section 8.2(d) of Article VIII:

(8.2)(d) Special Indemnity for Pending Disclosed Matters. Solely with respect to the following specific pending matters disclosed on Schedule 3.14 (each, a "Specified Pending Matter"), the Sellers shall indemnify Buyer against Losses arising out of or relating to:

(i) Item 1 — Trademark opposition, TTAB Opposition No. 91-284772, Lumenor Devices B.V. v. Trellis BioWorks, Inc. (opposing registration of the Company's mark TRELLIGEN, U.S. App. Serial No. 98/415,882) (the "TRELLIGEN Opposition"); and

(ii) Item 2 — Customer dispute, the written demand of Bexley Clinical Partners LLC dated 3 April 2026 (the "Bexley Claim").

The Sellers' liability under this Section 8.2(d) is expressly limited as follows:

(x) Scope. This special indemnity shall apply ONLY to the Specified Pending Matters identified in clauses (i) and (ii) above and to no other matter disclosed, or referenced in, Schedule 3.14. For the avoidance of doubt, the resolved matter disclosed as Schedule 3.14 Item 3 (the OSHA citation, Citation No. 1829445 (Region IV), relating to chemical-hygiene documentation at the Company's Norcross facility) is expressly excluded from the scope of this Section 8.2(d), and the Sellers shall have no indemnity liability under this Section 8.2(d) with respect to that resolved matter.

(y) Aggregate Cap. The aggregate liability of the Sellers under this Section 8.2(d) for all Specified Pending Matters shall not exceed Two Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($2,500,000).

(z) Survival. The Sellers' obligations under this Section 8.2(d) shall survive the Closing for a period of twenty-four (24) months following the Closing Date (the "Special Indemnity Survival Period"), and any claim under this Section 8.2(d) must be asserted in writing within such Special Indemnity Survival Period.

Interaction with Basket, Cap, and Escrow. This Section 8.2(d) is subject to, and shall not operate to modify or supersede, the other limitations of this Article VIII, and, notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the counterparty's markup, the parties confirm that:

(A) Basket. Claims for Losses under this Section 8.2(d) remain subject to the Deductible set forth in Section 8.3(a) (currently a true deductible of $400,000) and shall not convert that true deductible to a tipping basket;

(B) Cap. Losses under this Section 8.2(d) shall be counted toward, and remain subject to, the aggregate cap on the Sellers' liability set forth in Section 8.3(b), with the approved aggregate cap in clause (y) above serving as the specific, self-contained cap on this Section 8.2(d) special indemnity for the Specified Pending Matters; and

(C) Escrow / Order of Recovery. Claims under this Section 8.2(d) shall follow the same order of recovery set forth in Section 8.5, and Buyer shall recover first from the Escrow Amount and thereafter severally from the Sellers in proportion to their Pro Rata Shares; this Section 8.2(d) does not authorize direct recovery from the Sellers without first exhausting the Escrow Amount.

[Signature pages and remaining Article VIII text of the execution draft v4 are unaffected.]

Internal filing note (Trellis workspace only, not for transmittal): This counter-rider is filed under Trellis matter naming conventions as trellis-spa-special-indemnity-rider.docx. The counterparty's proposed filename (halberd-special-indemnity-schedule.docx), data-room mirroring request, and instruction to copy the deal paralegal are not adopted for the internal Trellis workspace; counterparty transmittal logistics apply only to outward delivery after sign-off, per approved position IP-5.
